text:
Priya Singh: Quick sync — planning a very narrow canary for model-7b-quant-v1 today. Objective: validate latency, KV cache behavior, and hallucination signal on a small QA set before broad ramp. Proposed initial split: 2% us-central (single region) + 0.5% apac-tok. Flag: feature.model_7b_quant.staged_canary

Owen Brooks: Sounds good. Can you post the rollback criteria so oncall knows thresholds?

Priya Singh: Draft guardrails below (keeping them tight):
```
flag: feature.model_7b_quant.staged_canary
audiences:
  - region: us-central-1
    pct: 2
  - region: apac-tok-1
    pct: 0.5
warmup_min: 8
fallback: model-7b-legacy
auto_cutoff:
  error_rate_p1m: 0.015   # suspend if >=1.5% errors in 1m
  p95_latency_ms: 900    # suspend if p95 > 900ms
  cpu_sustained_pct: 85   # suspend if CPU >85% for 5m
  hallucination_delta_pct: 6 # soft alert if hallucination rises >6%
```
(We'll run a 1k sample QA check for hallucination metric before and during canary)

Tomas Mueller: Can we make the US cohort land only in us-central-1 AZ-a to keep infra locality tight for the first 15m? Less noisy for tracing.

Priya Singh: Yep — start single AZ. If all green at +15m expand AZ and at +45m consider region expansion.

Maya Patel: Oncall for that window. I'll add the paging rule and a short runbook. Runbook highlights: immediate rollback command, check p95 and error rate first, then trace sampling for requests tagged model=7b-quant. I'll paste the rollback CLI in here when ready.

infra-bot: Alert subscriptions updated: #alerts-model-7b, eng-infra, oncall. Added SLO watch (route-level) and model namespace alerts.

Priya Singh: Rollout CLI I'll use: (dry-run tested)
```
rolloutctl apply feature.model_7b_quant --regions us-central-1,apac-tok-1 \
  --pct-us 2 --pct-apac 0.5 --az-filter us-central-1a \
  --auto-cutoff error_rate=0.015,p95=900,cpu=85
```
I'll wait 10m for final thumbs before executing.

Owen Brooks: Request: add a short log-sampling patch to the model runtime to include model_checksum and prompt_bucket in traces (5% sample). Helps correlate anomalies quickly. I can land it now — needs a quick review.

Tomas Mueller: +1 for log sampling. If Owen lands it, ops please ensure the extra logs are rate-limited.

Maya Patel: Thumbs-up for rollout from oncall POV once Owen's patch is merged. I want the first 5m health check to be manual review (I will confirm) before auto-cutoff is allowed to act.

priya: noted — toggling auto-cutoff to manual-first for first 5m. Update config: auto_cutoff.delay_min=5

rollout-bot: Preflight checks OK. Dry-run of rolloutctl succeeded. Ready when Priya says GO.

Priya Singh: GO at 14:30 UTC. Executing now.

rollout-bot: Executing rollout at 14:30 UTC (run id: rlt-20260412-03). Targets: us-central-1a (2%), apac-tok-1 (0.5%). Auto-cutoff delay 5m.

infra-bot: Initial health snapshot (1m): requests nominal, p95=420ms, error_rate=0.003, cpu_avg=52%. No auto-cutoff triggered.

Owen Brooks: Patch merged (log sampling 5%). Watch the traces for model_checksum correlation.

Maya Patel: Manual review @+5m: p95=460ms, error_rate=0.004, hallucination_sample_delta=+1.2% vs baseline. Manual green — allowing auto-cutoff to be active.

Tomas Mueller: I'll keep the autoscaler lock for 30m and pin burst capacity to avoid noisy scaling.

priya: thanks — plan: keep us-central at 2% for 30m, then widen AZs and bump us->15% at +60m if everything stable. apac stays tiny until region-level checks pass.

rollout-bot: 30m check (automated): p95=470ms, error_rate=0.005, cpu_sustained=57%, hallucination_delta=+1.8%. All within thresholds.

infra-bot: Note: observed a small spike in CPU for a single host at +22m (77% -> 88% for ~3m) but not sustained. Traced to one noisy client — mitigated by connection throttling.

Maya Patel: I'm keeping an eye; will escalate if we hit error_rate >=0.015 or p95 >=900ms. Otherwise stand-by for region bump at +60m.

Priya Singh: Thanks team. If we see quality regressions >5% or any sustained infra issues we'll rollback to model-7b-legacy with:
```
rolloutctl rollback rlt-20260412-03 --to model-7b-legacy --force
```

Owen Brooks: LGTM. I'll follow up with a short postmortem template in #eng-infra if anything interesting shows.

Maya Patel: All good at +60m — bumping us to 15% and expanding AZs now. apac remains at 0.5%.

rollout-bot: Expansion executed. New targets: us-central-1a,b,c (15% total), apac-tok-1 (0.5%). Monitoring hooks active.

infra-bot: 5m snapshot post-expansion: p95=490ms, error_rate=0.006, cpu_avg=63%. No cutoffs.

Priya Singh: Moving this into monitoring-only mode. I'll post a short summary in #product-updates later. Thanks everyone.

Maya Patel: Great job. Closing loop here; will keep watch for +24h signals.

Owen Brooks: :thumbsup:
